question: Can learning a positive decaying token-probability target on synthetic whole-sentence repetitions improve natural Japanese continuation and completion while all original gold CE and retention guards remain?
observations: Latest same-suffix context likelihood left long clause/sentence loops: base-011,026,045,056,066,089,096 repeat full statements; base-057 initially gives the correct count then loops. These known DEV examples motivate the question but their text/answers never become TRAIN. Main all80 coherence1 and appropriate1 fail; the cause is not established.
different_from_closed_UL: Inspected original sequence_unlikelihood.py and sequence_objective_trainer.py: decoded TRAIN-prefix greedy continuations, later token4gram mask, -log(1-p) toward zero at generated negatives. New method constructs whole original TRAIN sentence copies without rollouts; target is .5 times detached probability at the corresponding previous copy. If current probability is below this positive target it increases instead of being universally suppressed. Not an alpha/ngram/decoder rescue of that closed condition.
different_from_other_closed_conditions: Context mixing replaces main conditioning tokens while retaining hard gold; on-policy KD queries a frozen teacher on generated trajectories; confidence loss regularizes entropy; recent contrast matches suffix likelihood across distinct observed contexts. This intervention preserves every original main CE row and adds current-model adjacent-copy probability matching only.

primary_sources.summary: DITTO builds repeated TRAIN sentences and matches each later token probability to a detached decayed probability at its preceding copy. The paper uses factor0.5 and alternating repetition/MLE updates. Its word-level750M English and summarization results do not establish Japanese10M improvement.
primary_sources.title: Learning to Break the Loop: Analyzing and Mitigating Repetitions for Neural Text Generation

literature_limit: A prospective DITTO-inspired variant, not an exact paper reproduction. Here original gold CE is unchanged and auxiliary loss is simultaneous mean loss times0.1, deterministic first8 rows, at most16 copies/512 inputs, native4096 byte codec. No causal claim that self-reinforcement is the sole failure or that sentence penalization fixes phrase loops, arithmetic, relevance or EOS.
optimizer: Same original10B weights and fresh AdamW LR1e-5 WD0.1 betas0.9/0.999 eps1e-8, constant schedule and clip1; never use rejected or technical probe weights.

recipe.main_CE: All original body+EOS positions/masks unchanged; same source quota, fullsampler, digest, LR clock and main physical inputs as cached CE100M.
recipe.selection: Fully main-supervised original first-window complete body+EOS<=512. Earliest subsequent punctuation-ended sentence with original token/UTF8 boundaries,8..128 sentence tokens and8..256 preceding tokens. First8 distinct family/body eligible rows in original batch order, no reroll, loss filter or new draw.
recipe.construction: Original joint-body IDs, original preceding context and BOS once; repeat the full selected sentence4..16 copies fitting512 input predictions. No synthetic EOS/roles/markers. Preserve all skipped rows in main CE. No saved synthetic dataset.
recipe.loss: Mean -log(1-abs(p_current -0.5*stopgrad(p_corresponding_previous_copy))) at later plain-body copies. Original context and first copy do not receive auxiliary supervision. Stable logit/complement formula, no probability clipping.
recipe.inference: Unchanged native greedy64 and raw flags; no repetition blocking or forcedEOS.
recipe.accounting: Synthetic input positions and probability comparisons are separate from original CE teachers, unique data and model parameters.

CPU_scope: 14 analytic/saturated-gradient/detachment/boundary/preservation checks and one pinned32x48 TRAIN feasibility audit within30s; no model instantiation, forward, optimizer, DEV/TEST or GPU.
technical_gate: Implement dedicated native trainer with disabled-aux equality to original CE, full-state continuous vs resumed CPU fixtures, malformed-state rejection and interrupted-update protection. One owned CUDA<=180s: finite48x1024 CE and8x512 auxiliary backward, real fullstate resume including auxiliary,32 postwarmup timings and original stream parity. Verification weights stay WSL and never seed science.
science_forecast: Use exact17698 updates times measured mean full update duration,1.3 margin plus600s evaluation/save reserve; measured science cap plus all technical costs must fit4800s. No budget increase or batch rescue after failure.
science_prerequisites: Native trainer, typed fullstate runner, safe isolated DEV256/80/Japanese evaluator, all80 reviewer, durable launcher, exact frozen sources/recipe and measured closed GPU ledger; no use of old mixed reader.
quality: Preserve every original matched/strong/absolute/historical guard: all80 grammar>=56/coherence>=27/appropriate>=27/EOS>=37/repetition<=18 and Unicode/role/empty0, paired coherence gain>=8 with CI lower>0 and matched BPB nonworsening. Improvements in synthetic probabilities or repetition alone never qualify the Base.
failure: Close this fixed prospective condition on technical/stream/budget/quality failure. No decay/coefficient/copies/row count/sentence-boundary/parent/LR/seed/decoder/cap rescue, no automatic extension. Distinct next questions require their own prospective justification.
later: Only qualified recipe proceeds genuine fresh whole-pipeline independent learning, fullDEV/all440 individual content, final recipe seal, new sealedTEST and Base adoption. Chat/SFT/quantization/larger models/publication excluded.
